links.outcome: AUC of AI model versus BISAP clinical decision rule for sepsis, ICU admission, mortality
links.effect: AI model had superior AUC for sepsis (0.961 vs BISAP 0.785), ICU admission (0.973 vs 0.778), and mortality (0.975 vs 0.817).
links.quote: Compared to BISAP, the AI model had superior AUC for sepsis (BISAP 0.785), ICU admission (BISAP 0.778), and mortality (BISAP 0.817).

screen.reason: Evaluates a predictive risk model implemented into a hospital information system (HIS) for real-time prediction in ED patients with acute pancreatitis, comparing its performance to an existing clinical score (BISAP), but does not test a specific deployment safeguard/practice.
